question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", what are the VM-state rollups (VM state, total instances, total memory MB, total vCPUs), and for each matching VM state what is the migration activity category (Active/Inactive/Subtotal) and the average variance of migration memory total for non-deleted instances with non-completed/failed/confirmed/accepted/reverted/error migrations? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH BaseInstances AS (
  SELECT id, uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus
  FROM instances
  WHERE availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND deleted = 0
),
StateRollup AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_instances,
    SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb,
    SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM BaseInstances
  GROUP BY vm_state
  WITH ROLLUP
),
MigrationVariance AS (
  SELECT
    i.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS variance_memory_total
  FROM BaseInstances i
  JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'confirmed', 'accepted', 'reverted', 'error')
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
)
SELECT
  sr.vm_state,
  sr.total_instances,
  sr.total_memory_mb,
  sr.total_vcpus,
  CASE
    WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN mv.variance_memory_total IS NOT NULL THEN 'Active'
    ELSE 'Inactive'
  END AS migration_activity_category,
  mv.variance_memory_total AS avg_variance_migration_memory
FROM StateRollup sr
LEFT JOIN MigrationVariance mv ON sr.vm_state = mv.vm_state
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  sr.vm_state

WITH BaseInstances AS (
  SELECT id, uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus
  FROM instances
  WHERE availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND deleted = 0
),
StateRollup AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_instances,
    SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb,
    SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM BaseInstances
  GROUP BY vm_state
  WITH ROLLUP
),
MigrationVariance AS (
  SELECT
    i.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS variance_memory_total
  FROM BaseInstances i
  JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'confirmed', 'accepted', 'reverted', 'error')
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
)
SELECT
  sr.vm_state,
  sr.total_instances,
  sr.total_memory_mb,
  sr.total_vcpus,
  CASE
    WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN mv.variance_memory_total IS NOT NULL THEN 'Active'
    ELSE 'Inactive'
  END AS migration_activity_category,
  mv.variance_memory_total AS avg_variance_migration_memory
FROM StateRollup sr
LEFT JOIN MigrationVariance mv ON sr.vm_state = mv.vm_state
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  sr.vm_state

WITH BaseInstances AS (
  SELECT id, uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus
  FROM instances
  WHERE availability_zone = 'flare3'
    AND host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND deleted = 0
),
StateRollup AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_instances,
    SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb,
    SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM BaseInstances
  GROUP BY vm_state
  WITH ROLLUP
),
MigrationVariance AS (
  SELECT
    i.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(m.memory_total) AS variance_memory_total
  FROM BaseInstances i
  JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'confirmed', 'accepted', 'reverted', 'error')
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
)
SELECT
  sr.vm_state,
  sr.total_instances,
  sr.total_memory_mb,
  sr.total_vcpus,
  CASE
    WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 'Subtotal'
    WHEN mv.variance_memory_total IS NOT NULL THEN 'Active'
    ELSE 'Inactive'
  END AS migration_activity_category,
  mv.variance_memory_total AS avg_variance_migration_memory
FROM StateRollup sr
LEFT JOIN MigrationVariance mv ON sr.vm_state = mv.vm_state
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  sr.vm_state

  i.vm_state,
  COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances,
  SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb,
  SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(m.id) > 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS migration_activity_category,
  AVG(m.memory_total) AS avg_variance_migration_memory_total
FROM instances i
LEFT JOIN migrations m
  ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
 AND m.deleted = 0
 AND m.status NOT IN ('completed','failed','confirmed','accepted','reverted','error')
WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
  AND i.deleted = 0
GROUP BY i.vm_state
